product_one_liner.value: Mimica records employees’ work activity to map processes, reveal inefficiencies, and create production-ready AI agents for large enterprises.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes capturing clicks and keystrokes, mapping processes, automating work, and an enterprise focus.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page is shown; the contact page is an inquiry/demo form that directs prospects to ask product experts pricing questions.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations are named alongside customer testimonials on Mimica’s homepage.

employee_band.notes: The sources show about 310–316 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies London, United Kingdom as headquarters; Mimica’s own site gives its London address.

founded_year.notes: Mimica’s About Us timeline explicitly marks 2018 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The article index consists of product explainers, business-impact/marketing content, announcements, and company news; it does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public site’s homepage/footer provides no product documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link; the visible guides and articles are marketing resources rather than product docs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Ashby posting is titled Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer and includes an application link.

model_provider.notes: Mimica’s AI-agent engineering job description names these as example models/providers, not as a single exclusive default.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists ISO 27001:2022; Mimica’s homepage also states that it is compliant with GDPR.

last_funding.notes: Mimica announced a $26.2 million Series B on 2025-09-24; its company timeline lists the 2025 Series B as its latest funding milestone.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B was announced 2025-09-24, inside the 18-month period beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Mimica has an active Associate Business Development Representative posting with an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Mimica announced Maker on 2026-09-30, within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The About Us page lists the founders as CEO and CTO but does not provide a complete executive roster or dated C-level/VP appointment/departure history, so a change in the 12 months before 2026-11-09 cannot be verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Associate Business Development Representative posting says to keep Salesforce updated.
